issue.title: Conflict between Resource class attribute and new almanac interface endpoints

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the bug, but the existing test phabricator/tests/test_phabricator.py::PhabricatorTest.test_endpoint_shadowing passed before the fix and fails after it, so the fix introduces a regression. Look first at why the fix breaks test_endpoint_shadowing, likely around how Resource attributes such as interface are now resolved, and note that no test was found guarding the reported b…
